newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes stable in thin talk.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes stable in thin talk.

text.p: The Singapore bunker market was quiet on Thurday with few enquiries heard, traders said.
As the fuel oil cargo market was stable, the bunker market hardly moved, they said. "Demand does not improve. You can only get routine customers," said one supplier.
Some shipowners were only "shopping around" but not keen in buying, said one trader.
The 380-cst grade was quoted at $97/$98 per tonne and the 180-cst was at around $104. MDO and gas oil were quoted around $190 and $200 respectively.
